req.title: Reject malformed player payload
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity when POST /players/ receives a body that fails Player schema validation.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-009 requires HTTP 422 when POST /players/ receives a body failing PlayerRequestModel schema validation. PlayerRequestModel has three required fields (first_name, last_name, position) and one required int (squad_number). Tests cover: (1) positive — a fully valid payload returns 201, confirming the happy path and that 422 is not spuriously returned; (2) negative — completely empty body returns 422; (3) negative — missing required field 'first_name' returns 422; (4) negative — missing required field 'last_name' returns 422; (5) negative — missing required field 'position' returns 422; (6) negative — missing required field 'squad_number' returns 422; (7) boundary — squad_number supplied as a non-integer string returns 422; (8) boundary — empty string for required str field 'first_name' (Pydantic accepts non-empty constraint only if min_length set; since no min_length is set, empty string is valid — this tests the boundary between empty and absent). All tests use exact status code assertions and inspect the 'detail' key structure to catch constant/comparison mutations.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_payload_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
squad_number 99 does not exist in the pre-loaded database
actions: POST /players/ with a fully valid PlayerRequestModel payload (all required fields present and correctly typed, squad_number=99)
expected: HTTP 201 Created
Response body contains firstName, lastName, position, squadNumber matching the submitted values
Response body contains an 'id' UUID field
trace: R-PLAYER-009 — positive path: valid payload must NOT trigger 422
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_payload_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body

tests.name: test_post_player_empty_body_returns_422
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
actions: POST /players/ with an empty JSON object {}
expected: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity
Response body contains 'detail' key with validation error list
Errors reference missing required fields: first_name, last_name, squad_number, position
trace: R-PLAYER-009 — error pathway: empty body fails all required field validations
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_empty_body_returns_422():
    r = client.post("/players/", json={})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert isinstance(body["detail"], list)
    assert len(body["detail"]) >= 1
    missing_fields = {err["loc"][-1] for err in body["detail"]}
    assert "first_name" in missing_fields or "firstName" in missing_fields
    assert "last_name" in missing_fields or "lastName" in missing_fields
    assert "squad_number" in missing_fields or "squadNumber" in missing_fields
    assert "position" in missing_fields
